voice.unknownPrompt: I couldn't fully understand. Try saying one of these:
voice.alreadyPaidTitle: 🚨 Important: If you already sent money!
voice.alreadyPaidStep1: 1. Call your bank immediately and ask them to freeze/stop the transfer.
voice.alreadyPaidStep2: 2. Immediately call the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930 (Free).
voice.alreadyPaidStep3: 3. Keep your chat screenshots and bank receipts safe as evidence.
voice.alreadyPaidTakeaway: Rule: Time is key! Reporting within the first 2 hours (Golden Hour) gives the highest chance of recovery.
voice.alreadyPaidSpeak: Call your bank immediately to stop the transfer, and dial 1930 to report to the Cyber Police.
voice.complaintStep1: 1. Call 1930 and explain the incident to the police officer.
voice.complaintStep3: 3. For stock frauds, lodge a complaint on SEBI's SCORES portal.
voice.complaintTakeaway: Remember: Official police registration is completely free. Never pay anyone to recover your money.
voice.complaintSpeak: You can register your complaint by dialing 1930 or visiting cybercrime.gov.in.
voice.nomineeStep1: 1. Open your bank or mutual fund app and select 'Nomination'.
voice.nomineeStep2: 2. Enter your nominee's name, birthdate, and PAN/ID details.
voice.nomineeStep3: 3. Submit the form and check for the confirmation SMS.
voice.nomineeTakeaway: Rule: Adding a nominee is very important. It ensures your family receives your savings easily.
voice.nomineeSpeak: To add a nominee, go to the nomination section of your bank or investment account and enter your family member's details.
voice.rightsStep1: 1. You have the right to get full and correct details of your investment.
voice.rightsStep2: 2. You have the right to complain against delayed services or fraud.
voice.rightsStep3: 3. You have the right to withdraw your money from SEBI-registered brokers anytime.
voice.rightsTakeaway: Rule: No broker can block your money forcefully. It is illegal.
voice.rightsSpeak: As an investor, you have the full right to lodge complaints and withdraw your funds at any time.
voice.docStep1: 1. Always check for official government seals or SEBI/RBI logos at the top.
voice.docStep2: 2. Read the terms and fees carefully. Avoid transfer to personal accounts.
voice.docStep3: 3. If doubtful, upload the document on NiveshShield to check.
voice.docTakeaway: Rule: Never sign any document without reading and understanding it fully.
voice.docSpeak: Read documents carefully. Check for SEBI or RBI logos and never sign unknown papers.
voice.verifyStep1: 1. Always ask for their 12-digit SEBI Registration Number.
voice.verifyStep2: 2. Verify this number on the official sebi.gov.in website.
voice.verifyStep3: 3. Do not trust investment tips from WhatsApp or Telegram groups.
voice.verifyTakeaway: Rule: Registered advisors never ask you to send money to personal bank accounts.
voice.verifySpeak: Ask for their SEBI registration number and verify it on sebi.gov.in before investing.

onboarding.welcome: Welcome to NiveshShield. We help you check suspicious messages, photos, links and voice messages.
onboarding.textMessage: To check an investment message or offer, copy and paste it into the Text Message box.
onboarding.photo: If you have a screenshot of a WhatsApp group or an image, tap Photo or Screenshot to upload it.
onboarding.website: If someone sends you a website link, paste it into Website Link to check if it's suspicious.
onboarding.voice: You can also speak your queries directly instead of typing.
onboarding.ask: Use Ask NiveshShield to ask about your rights, how to complain, or what to do if you already lost money.
onboarding.safetyVideos: Tap Safety Videos to watch short official awareness videos and learn how to protect yourself.
onboarding.takeYourTime: Take your time. Always check before you trust or send money.
